content: Common RN pattern for an animated count-up number (e.g. live HSS ticking up in the sticky header): drive a Reanimated shared value with withTiming from the old to new HSS value on every commit, then render via useAnimatedProps on an AnimatedTextInput (editable=false) or a small Reanimated-driven text component, formatting the interpolated value each frame. Off-the-shelf libraries (react-native-animated-numbers, use-count-up) exist but add a dependency for a small amount of logic; given CLAUDE.md's 'ask before adding others' dependency policy, a ~20-line custom Reanimated hook is the recommended approach over a new package.
